resources.string: Skip setup. You can run it again from Settings.
A keyboard for Amharic, Tigrinya, Afaan Oromoo and English. Setup takes about a minute.
Typing works fully offline. You do not need an account to type.
What you type stays on your device. The keyboard hands it only to the app you are typing in; it does not store it or send it anywhere.
This version has no AI features. If they are added, they will be optional and will run only when you ask for them.
Your keyboard settings are stored on this device.
Read the full privacy notice in your browser
Android needs you to switch Qal Smart Keyboard on in the system keyboard list. Tap the button, turn on Qal Smart Keyboard, then come back here.
Qal Smart Keyboard is turned on.
Qal Smart Keyboard is not turned on yet.
Android shows a general warning that any keyboard can see what you type. The privacy notice in the first step says what this keyboard does.
Now pick Qal Smart Keyboard as the keyboard you type with. Tap the button and choose it in the list that appears.
Qal Smart Keyboard is your current keyboard.
Choose the languages you type in. The first one is used when the keyboard opens; the globe key moves to the next language in this order. You can change this later in Settings.
How do you want to type %1$s?
Type with Latin letters, for example selam, and get ሰላም.
Tap a consonant, then a vowel key.
Tap the box and type. If the keyboard does not appear, go back and choose Qal Smart Keyboard.
Type here to try the keyboard
Qal Smart Keyboard is not your current keyboard, so the box below will use another one.
Phonetic: type selam and tap the word on the strip above the keys (or press space) to get ሰላም.
Fidel grid: tap a consonant, then a vowel key. Or long-press a consonant and slide to the form you want.
Globe key: tap to go to the next language.
Globe key: long-press to switch between the layouts of the current language (for example phonetic, Fidel and ABC).
ABC key: switches to plain Latin letters and back.
Space bar: long-press to pick a language from a list.
Punctuation: while typing in Amharic or Tigrinya, long-press . or , for ። ፣ ፤ and more.
Words marked DRAFT come from language data that is still being reviewed.
Turn on and choose the keyboard, pick languages and try it out.
Words you add or the keyboard learns as you type. They stay on this device, encrypted, and are never uploaded. Nothing is learned in password fields or when a field asks for no personalised learning.
All added and learned words and word pairs, in every language, are deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
You do not need an account to type. Sign in only if you want account features when they arrive; you can do this later in Settings.
Tap Continue to skip this step.

Keep the words you added or the keyboard learned on all your devices. Words are encrypted on our servers and decrypted only to deliver them to your devices over a secure connection. You can turn this off at any time.
Sign in with your phone number or Google account to sync your dictionary. Guest sessions cannot.
